data.name: Parvisha
data.gender_notes: Parvisha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is a virgin, pure, chaste, and modest. The name Parvisha carries the meaning “Maiden, Damsel, Girl” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Parvisha usually hope their child will grow to embody maiden, damsel, girl and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine feminine energy, purity, and grace
data.etymology: Parvisha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Maiden, Damsel, Girl.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Parvisha total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
